  "title": "Regulate Temperature — draft derived description and requirements",
  "system_description": "The selected material defines Regulate_Temperature_i, a system intended to regulate air temperature. Its boundary includes four processes: regulator interface management, heat source management, regulator mode management, and internal failure detection. Each process contains a corresponding thread. The external operator interface supplies lower and upper desired temperatures with validity status and receives regulator status and a temperature value for display. An external temperature sensor supplies current temperature with validity status. The system supplies an on/off command to an external heat source. These input values are the monitored quantities at the modeled boundary; regulator status, displayed temperature, and the heat command are the controlled outputs. The material does not establish a physical temperature-maintenance performance guarantee. Internally, the interface manager supplies desired temperatures and an interface failure flag; the failure detector supplies an internal failure flag; and the mode manager supplies Init, Normal, or Failed mode. The heat manager determines specified heater commands from mode and temperature comparisons. All four threads are periodic with a 1000 ms period. Process/thread decomposition, typed data ports, connections, scheduling domains, and periods are source-defined implementation choices, distinct from the functional behavior expressed in comments and contracts. The requirements below are draft extractions from the selected source, not an independently established specification or a validation result.",

response.system_description: The selected material defines Regulate_Temperature_i, a system intended to regulate air temperature. Its boundary includes four processes: regulator interface management, heat source management, regulator mode management, and internal failure detection. Each process contains a corresponding thread. The external operator interface supplies lower and upper desired temperatures with validity status and receives regulator status and a temperature value for display. The heat manager determines specified heater commands from mode and temperature comparisons. All four threads are periodic with a 1000 ms period.
